days.title: Northern Heights and Villages
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: punta della Scomunica
stops.detail: Its highest point is Punta della Scomunica (408 m a.s.l.), followed by Punta Maestra (265 meters), Punta Tumbarino (241 meters), Monte Ruda (215 meters), and Punta Marcutza (195 meters).

stops.name: cala d'Oliva
stops.detail: The watercourses are predominantly seasonal and feed some artificial reservoirs that served the prison structures and the village of Cala d'Oliva.

stops.name: Elighe Mannu
stops.detail: Only in the locality of Elighe Mannu is there a small original formation of holm oak forest (Quercus ilex).

days.title: Central Nature and History
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Cala Scombro di Dentro
stops.detail: The small rocks near Cala Scombro di Dentro host important colonies of European shag (Phalacrocorax aristotelis).

stops.name: ossario austro-ungarico
stops.detail: In addition to the structures that were part of the prison complex, there is an Austro-Hungarian ossuary on the island erected in the 1930s.

stops.name: Osservatorio Faunistico del Parco
stops.detail: In the Tumbarino locality, the Park's Wildlife Observatory is active.
